hook.name: DeltaHook
hook.description: A wave-tax hook that applies zone-aware swap taxes: buys always pay a 3% baseline ETH tax in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta, with ETH rebates paid in afterSwap to buyers in peak (net −3%) or dip (net −6%) price zones relative to the running ATH. Sells are taxed 3% normally or 12% during deep dips, funding the rebate vault.
